segments.en: Every hotel runs on one formula. Available rooms, times occupancy, times rate. Minus channel cost. Minus labour.
zh: 每一家酒店都靠同一个公式运转：
可售房晚 × 入住率 × 房价，
减去渠道成本，减去人力。

segments.en: And every day, a little of it leaks away. Empty rooms nobody saw coming. Prices set wrong. A low rate left online overnight. A bad review that costs the next booking.
zh: 每一天，收入都在悄悄流失：
没提前看到的空房，定错的价格，
挂了一夜的低价，赶走下一单的差评。

segments.en: Not because managers don't care. Because no one can watch five back offices, every hour, every day.
zh: 不是店长不上心，
而是没有人能每小时盯着五个后台。

segments.en: Hogent X gives every hotel a team of digital employees. A revenue manager. A guest relations specialist. A quality inspector. And a general manager's assistant.
zh: HogentX 给每一家酒店配一支数字员工队伍：
收益经理、宾客关系专员、
质检主管、总经理助理。

segments.en: They read the hotel's booking platforms around the clock. They spot the change, check it, and prepare the action. And one rule never changes: the AI only reads. Every price change, every reply, is confirmed by a person.
zh: 它们全天候读取各订房平台，
发现变化、核查、准备方案。
一条规则始终不变：AI 只读取数据，
每一次改价、每一条回复，都由人工确认。

segments.en: We tested it in our own hotels first. Twenty-nine properties, in one of the thinnest-margin segments in the business. Six daily tasks went from four hundred and eighty minutes a day to one hundred and seventy-four. About sixty-four percent less time, measured in-house.
zh: 我们先在自己的酒店验证：
29 家门店，利润最薄的业态之一。
六项日常任务从每天 480 分钟降到 174 分钟，
减少约 64%，内部口径。

segments.en: Now we are bringing it to Singapore and Malaysia. Five languages. Agoda and Booking dot com are already connected. And we plan to host hotel data in Singapore.
zh: 现在，我们把它带到新加坡和马来西亚：
五种语言，已接入 Agoda 与 Booking.com，
数据拟托管于新加坡。

segments.en: Fewer people, watching more. Revenue risks, seen in time. Hogent X. The hotel digital employee that understands the business.
zh: 用更少的人，提前看到收入风险。
HogentX，懂经营的酒店数字员工。
